caseName: Ex parte of St. Louis, Kansas City & Colorado Railroad
caseNameFull: Ex parte: In the Matter of St. Louis, Kansas City & Colorado Railroad Company

opinions.text: Motions for leave to file petitions for writs of prohibition and mandamus denied, without prejudice in any respect to relief on appeal or otherwise on the merits. Mr. Thomas P. Littlepage, Mr. Paul E. Walker, Mr. James C. Jones, Mr. Lon O. Hocker, Mr. Frank D. Sullivan and Mr. Marcus L. Bell for the petitioner.
